audit_items.proof_trace: handle_withdraw calls withdraw_ctokens (L328) to mutate the obligation's ctoken balance before invoking is_obligation_safe (L332-342), which checks collateral_weighted >= borrow_weight_weighted_debt on the post-withdrawal state. The weighted check (collateral_factor ≤ 1.0, borrow_weight ≥ 1.0) is strictly more conservative than the plain debt/collateral < 1.0 threshold, so any withdrawal violating the plain ratio also fails this check. The assert at L342 aborts the entire transaction on failure, reverting all changes.
